# Amrith Shanbhag

> Amrith spent a decade growing communities for consumer startups including Product Hunt. Now he builds his own ideas under Aspatial, his indie lab.

Amrith (@amrith) is a builder and a community and organic-growth generalist. For roughly ten years he was the first non-technical hire and the community and growth lead across consumer tech, known for organic, zero-spend growth, community building, brand, ASO/SEO, and product-led growth. He thinks of himself as the bridge between the team building a product and the people it is for: getting them to care, and turning them into the product's best marketers. Today he builds his own consumer products under Aspatial, for the love of the game.

## Aspatial
Everything Amrith builds lives under [Aspatial](https://aspatial.co), his independent lab. Aspatial is an adjective: not relating to, limited to, or associated with a particular space or area. It is the quiet root beneath a set of separate tools and spaces, each keeping its own name and identity, and none of them tied to one place or one kind of problem.

## Building now
- [Samooh](https://samooh.com): a community for Indian-origin founders building global products. The long game, and the most personal.
- [Timebase](https://timebase.me): a calmer way to visualize and plan across time zones; get countdowns to events on your calendar, and plan meetings at a time that works for everyone.
- [Shio](https://shio.sh): a mobile-first terminal built for the agent era.

## Experimenting with (under Aspatial)
- [Pasture](https://pasture.sh): a native iOS app that brings local AI to your iPhone, pairing with Ollama on your Mac with zero setup; nothing leaves your devices. The predecessor to Shio.
- [Stem](https://stem.md): the place your curiosity is looking for. A social platform for documenting your rabbit holes and niche interests, and exploring others'. Find trails worth following; leave trails worth finding.
- [Medivalent](https://medivalent.com): cross-border medicine equivalence; find the local equivalent of a medicine in another country.

## Fun side projects (by Samooh)
- [Dhuni](https://dhuni.net): a 24/7 internet radio for Indian classical, Hindustani, Carnatic, instrumental, and vintage music; a quiet listening world for deep focus.
- [Biriyani](https://biriyani.wiki): a visual archive of India's regional biriyani dialects, parallel dishes that share a name. Where each comes from, what sets it apart, and who still cooks it right.

## Past lives
- [Feathrd](https://feathrd.co) (2014–2017, where it started): a high school side project that became a community of 100+ student makers across 15 countries, collaborating and launching things on Product Hunt. The thing that started everything — including the Product Hunt chapter.
- [Product Hunt](https://producthunt.com/@amrith) (2017–2020, Head of Social): joined the community team as an intern, left as Head of Social. Grew the Twitter audience from 200K to 400K+ followers — all organic, zero spend — and refined the voice that still runs.
- [Opal](https://opalapp.com) (2020–2022, founding team): the first full-time hire doing things that don't scale. Built community, audience, and brand voice from zero, and moved to Paris to do it. Now a focus app used by millions.
- [Stoic](https://getstoic.com) (2023–2024, first growth hire): first dedicated growth hire at the journaling app (YC S19). Rebuilt the landing page, blog, SEO/ASO, and a Discord that went from 0 to hundreds of power users.
- [Envision](https://letsenvision.com) (2025–2026, marketing generalist): marketing generalist for smart glasses and assistive tech that give independence to people who are blind or have low vision. His first hardware and on-site role, and the most rewarding.
- And others.

## Personal
- [Sando](https://sandoinu.com) (the love of his life, since 2021): Amrith's first dog and best friend, the sweetest shiba you'll meet. Born in Normandy, raised in Paris, now in Amsterdam — about as French as a shiba can get. Posh, classy, elegant — with some exceptions.

## Working together
Amrith is happy to talk to founders building in consumer who want help with community, organic growth, ASO/SEO, and product-led growth. No pitch necessary.
